summary: Add a customer_note column, copy existing note values, create a BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE trigger that synchronises note and customer_note in both directions, deploy the new version with a state-only migration, run a backfill UPDATE, retire the old version, and drop the note column.
write_consistency: A BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE trigger copies the newly written value from note to customer_note and vice‑versa, ensuring that writes from either version are reflected in both columns.
revision_notes: The previous plan failed because the trigger function logic did not properly handle UPDATE when both columns changed, and the elif chain caused some rows to remain desynchronised. The revised trigger uses distinct comparisons and separate IF blocks for each column, so that any change to note or customer_note is mirrored to the other column, keeping them equal throughout the overlap.

stages.description: Add customer_note column, copy existing note values, and create a sync trigger.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD COLUMN customer_note TEXT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sync_note_customer_note() RETURNS trigger AS $$ BEGIN IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN IF NEW.note IS NOT NULL THEN NEW.customer_note := NEW.note; END IF; IF NEW.customer_note IS NOT NULL THEN NEW.note := NEW.customer_note; END IF; ELSIF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN IF NEW.note IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.note THEN IF NEW.note IS NOT NULL THEN NEW.customer_note := NEW.note; ELSE NEW.customer_note := NULL; END IF; END IF; IF NEW.customer_note IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.customer_date THEN IF NEW.customer_note IS NOT NULL THEN NEW.note := NEW.customer_note; ELSE NEW.note := NULL; END IF; END IF; END IF; RETURN NEW; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
CREATE TRIGGER sync_note_customer_note BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON account_user FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION sync_note_customer_note();

stages.description: Synchronise customer_note with note for all rows.
Retire the old version, stopping traffic from the old code.
Drop the note column since the old version is retired.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user DROP COLUMN note;
